hypothesis_title: Iter 28 — SOTA Optimizer Race (7 SOTA Methods × STR_1701 Base)
hypothesis_description:
Iter 28 — 사용자 mandate 직접 반영: 2026년 SOTA 비중결정 방법론 7종을 STR_1701 base에 모두 적용 + 비교.

## 동기 (사용자 mandate)
- 본 sprint cycle (Iter 11~22b) Optimizer는 모두 2010s 이전 methodology
- LinTilt (1990s) / ERC (2010) / MVO (1952) / BL (1992) / LinTilt+EMA+CVaR (2010s combo)
- 2024-2026 SOTA 미적용 — 본 sprint = SOTA 7 method race

## 핵심 가설 — 7 SOTA Method Comparison

### 1. DRO Wasserstein (Blanchet-Murthy 2024)
- min_w max_{Q ∈ Bε(P)} E_Q[loss(w, R)]
- ε = ambiguity radius (자율 sweep)
- 추정 오차 자체를 set으로 모델링
- L-229 Optimizer mechanism alone 한계 직접 해결 영역

### 2. HERC (Raffinot 2018)
- Hierarchical Equal Risk Contribution
- single-linkage clustering + recursive bisection (HRP) + ERC within hierarchy
- ERC near-EW 한계 (L-226) 보강

### 3. HRP + Tail-aware Clustering (Bourgeron 2024)
- HRP base + tail-dependence based distance metric
- Patton 2006 copula distance
- Iter 21/22/22b L-231/232/233 학습 활용

### 4. Confidence-aware Bayesian MVO (Kolm-Ritter 2024)
- alpha posterior = (Σ⁻¹ + Ω⁻¹)⁻¹ × (Σ⁻¹×μ_eq + Ω⁻¹×alpha_view)
- per-name confidence vector (Iter 14 학습)
- shrinkage intensity 동적

### 5. DiffOpt End-to-End (Chow-Zhang 2023)
- CVXPY + DiffOpt → loss = portfolio metric (Sharpe / CVaR)
- alpha + optimizer joint gradient
- (구현 복잡도 높음, Phase 1 simple proxy 가능)

### 6. MaxDiv (Choueifaty 2008)
- max (w'σ) / sqrt(w'Σw) — diversification ratio
- weights orthogonal in σ space
- ERC variant 비교 baseline

### 7. Tail-conditioned Risk Parity (Bourgeron 2024)
- ERC base + CVaR contribution equal
- 위기 시 자동 redistribution
- AX-001 v2 conditional 강화 영역

## 평가 (PG2 incremental)
- 7 method × net_IR / SR / CAGR / MDD / CVaR / TO 정량 비교
- AX-001 v2 4-metric 측정
- PG2 blended (best 80% + STR_1656 20%) realized SR > 1.4625
- Best 1-2 method → Forge realized backtest

## 13 sprint 학습 BLOCKING
- L-220 monthly base
- L-226 alpha activation 강화 (DRO/HERC/Bayesian가 ERC near-EW 한계 해결)
- L-229 Optimizer alone insufficient — DRO가 직접 해결
- L-231 continuous overlay 회피
- L-232/233 long-only defensive — SOTA method는 mathematical robust
- L-234 single-component defense — 7 method ensemble candidate

## 핵심 mandate
- alpha base: STR_1701 그대로 (cor ≥ 0.95 strict)
- Optimizer: 7 SOTA method 동시 비교 + best selection
- Hard caps: max_names 20 / weight bounds [0, 0.20] / Σw=1 / long-only
- AX-001 v2 4-metric primary
- Codex resolution 9/9 (OVERRIDE_005 fallback)
